name: Lord Hazard's Signet
description: Golden signet ring of the Hazard rulers, bound to each new Lord at the coronation.

name: Gambler's Graven Gift
description: Skull-engraved bone die from Rilausia's gambling houses; brings fortune and ruin.

name: The Evanglessian 51st Cavalier Division's Emblem
description: Cheap steel emblem of the 51st (ironbird pilots); glory in battle and a safe return.

name: Pike's Feather
description: Feather in bank robber Danny Pike's hat; it never gets damaged.

name: The Poor Man's Mark
description: Black ink tattooed as an eye on a victim; it reappears if removed.

name: The Stray Cat's Eye
description: Green tiger's-eye gem in an old Haudi brooch; it ruins thieves (bound to whoever steals it).

name: Ruinous Rifle
description: Antique Evanglessian military rifle, cursed by a gnome priest in the Loveless Wars.

name: Albrecht's Pipe
description: Pipe given to the Aldamiir fop Albrecht by a feuding family.
